ar: الطور
en: Sura 52: At-Tur

p.src: 52:1  By the mount of Tūr[1],

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ
en: By the mount of Tūr[1],
u.src: 52:1  By the mount of Tūr[1],

en: [1] Where Allah Almighty communicated with Moses (عليه السلام).

p.src: 52:2  and by the Book inscribed[2]

ar: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
en: and by the Book inscribed[2]
u.src: 52:2  and by the Book inscribed[2]

en: [2] i.e., the Qur’an.

p.src: 52:3  on an unrolled parchment[3],

ar: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
en: on an unrolled parchment[3],
u.src: 52:3  on an unrolled parchment[3],

en: [3] i.e., a spread-out scroll.

p.src: 52:4  and by the much-frequented House[4],

ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
en: and by the much-frequented House[4],
u.src: 52:4  and by the much-frequented House[4],

en: [4] Which is frequented by angels or the Ka‘bah in Makkah which is frequented by pilgrims.

p.src: 52:5  and by the canopy raised high,

ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
en: and by the canopy raised high,
u.src: 52:5  and by the canopy raised high,

p.src: 52:6  and by the sea set on fire[5].

ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
en: and by the sea set on fire[5].
u.src: 52:6  and by the sea set on fire[5].

en: [5] On the Day of Resurrection, or "by the overflowed sea."

p.src: 52:7  The punishment of your Lord will surely come to pass;

ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
en: The punishment of your Lord will surely come to pass;
u.src: 52:7  The punishment of your Lord will surely come to pass;

p.src: 52:8  there is none who can avert it.

ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
en: there is none who can avert it.
u.src: 52:8  there is none who can avert it.

p.src: 52:9  On the Day when the heaven will convulse violently[6],

ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
en: On the Day when the heaven will convulse violently[6],
u.src: 52:9  On the Day when the heaven will convulse violently[6],

en: [6] The heavens will be shaken violently, indicating the occurrence of the Hour. The word "maur" originally means turning round, rotating, swinging, swaying, etc.

p.src: 52:10  and the mountains will move a horrible movement[7].

ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
en: and the mountains will move a horrible movement[7].
u.src: 52:10  and the mountains will move a horrible movement[7].

en: [7] They will turn into dust, moving as clouds.

p.src: 52:11  Then woe to the deniers on that Day,

ar: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Then woe to the deniers on that Day,
u.src: 52:11  Then woe to the deniers on that Day,

p.src: 52:12  those who amuse themselves in falsehood.

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: those who amuse themselves in falsehood.
u.src: 52:12  those who amuse themselves in falsehood.

p.src: 52:13  On the Day when they will be shoved into the Fire forcefully,

ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
en: On the Day when they will be shoved into the Fire forcefully,
u.src: 52:13  On the Day when they will be shoved into the Fire forcefully,

p.src: 52:14  [They will be told,] “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

ar: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: [They will be told,] “This is the Fire which you used to deny.
u.src: 52:14  [They will be told,] “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

p.src: 52:15  Is this [punishment] magic, or do you not see?

ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
en: Is this [punishment] magic, or do you not see?
u.src: 52:15  Is this [punishment] magic, or do you not see?

p.src: 52:16  Burn in it, whether you bear it patiently or impatiently, it makes no difference to you[8]; you are recompensed only for what you used to do.”

ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: Burn in it, whether you bear it patiently or impatiently, it makes no difference to you[8]; you are recompensed only for what you used to do.”
u.src: 52:16  Burn in it, whether you bear it patiently or impatiently, it makes no difference to you[8]; you are recompensed only for what you used to do.”

en: [8] He who is patient during afflictions in the life of this world will be rewarded. As for the Hereafter, suffering patiently in Hell will not bring any reward or benefit.

p.src: 52:17  Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and bliss,

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and bliss,
u.src: 52:17  Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and bliss,

p.src: 52:18  enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

ar: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.
u.src: 52:18  enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

p.src: 52:19  “Eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do,

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: “Eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do,
u.src: 52:19  “Eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do,

p.src: 52:20  reclining on couches all lined up”. And We will marry them to houris with wide beautiful eyes.

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
en: reclining on couches all lined up”. And We will marry them to houris with wide beautiful eyes.
u.src: 52:20  reclining on couches all lined up”. And We will marry them to houris with wide beautiful eyes.

p.src: 52:21  As for those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will cause their offspring to join them, and will not detract anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Everyone will be accountable for what he earned[9].

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
en: As for those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will cause their offspring to join them, and will not detract anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Everyone will be accountable for what he earned[9].
u.src: 52:21  As for those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will cause their offspring to join them, and will not detract anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Everyone will be accountable for what he earned[9].

en: [9] i.e., None will be held responsible for the burden of another.

p.src: 52:22  And We will provide them with whatever fruit and meat they desire.

ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
en: And We will provide them with whatever fruit and meat they desire.
u.src: 52:22  And We will provide them with whatever fruit and meat they desire.

p.src: 52:23  They will pass around to one another a glass [of pure wine] which does not lead to idle talk or sin.

ar: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
en: They will pass around to one another a glass [of pure wine] which does not lead to idle talk or sin.
u.src: 52:23  They will pass around to one another a glass [of pure wine] which does not lead to idle talk or sin.

p.src: 52:24  They will be served by their servant boys, as if they were well-protected pearls.

ar: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
en: They will be served by their servant boys, as if they were well-protected pearls.
u.src: 52:24  They will be served by their servant boys, as if they were well-protected pearls.

p.src: 52:25  They will turn to one another with questions[10].

ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
en: They will turn to one another with questions[10].
u.src: 52:25  They will turn to one another with questions[10].

en: [10] They will probably ask one another about their worldly lives and what led them to Paradise.

p.src: 52:26  They will say, “Before this, we used to be in awe [of Allah] when we were living among our people.

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
en: They will say, “Before this, we used to be in awe [of Allah] when we were living among our people.
u.src: 52:26  They will say, “Before this, we used to be in awe [of Allah] when we were living among our people.

p.src: 52:27  Therefore Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
en: Therefore Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
u.src: 52:27  Therefore Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

p.src: 52:28  Indeed, we used to call upon Him before. He is indeed the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.”

ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: Indeed, we used to call upon Him before. He is indeed the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.”
u.src: 52:28  Indeed, we used to call upon Him before. He is indeed the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.”

p.src: 52:29  So keep exhorting [O Prophet], for you are not, by the grace of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
en: So keep exhorting [O Prophet], for you are not, by the grace of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
u.src: 52:29  So keep exhorting [O Prophet], for you are not, by the grace of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

p.src: 52:30  Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await a misfortune[11]”?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
en: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await a misfortune[11]”?
u.src: 52:30  Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await a misfortune[11]”?

en: [11] i.e., inevitable death or so.

p.src: 52:31  Say, “Wait, I too am waiting with you.”

ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
en: Say, “Wait, I too am waiting with you.”
u.src: 52:31  Say, “Wait, I too am waiting with you.”

p.src: 52:32  Do their minds[12] prompt them to say such things, or are they transgressing people?

ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
en: Do their minds[12] prompt them to say such things, or are they transgressing people?
u.src: 52:32  Do their minds[12] prompt them to say such things, or are they transgressing people?

en: [12] The leaders of pagans in Makkah claimed to be of great minds. Here it questions their intelligence, arguing that a man cannot be a madman and a poet at the same time.

p.src: 52:33  Or do they say, “He has made this [Qur’an] up”? Rather, they are not willing to believe.

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: Or do they say, “He has made this [Qur’an] up”? Rather, they are not willing to believe.
u.src: 52:33  Or do they say, “He has made this [Qur’an] up”? Rather, they are not willing to believe.

p.src: 52:34  Then let them produce a discourse like this, if they are truthful[13].

ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
en: Then let them produce a discourse like this, if they are truthful[13].
u.src: 52:34  Then let them produce a discourse like this, if they are truthful[13].

en: [13] Arab pagans were challenged to produce the like of this Quran, ten surahs, or one surah, but the challenge has never been met until the present day. See 2:23, 11:13, 52:34.

p.src: 52:35  Were they created by none, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
en: Were they created by none, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
u.src: 52:35  Were they created by none, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

p.src: 52:36  Or did they create the heavens and earth? Rather, they are not certain in faith.

ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
en: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Rather, they are not certain in faith.
u.src: 52:36  Or did they create the heavens and earth? Rather, they are not certain in faith.

p.src: 52:37  Or do they possess the treasures of your Lord, or do they have full control [of everything]?

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
en: Or do they possess the treasures of your Lord, or do they have full control [of everything]?
u.src: 52:37  Or do they possess the treasures of your Lord, or do they have full control [of everything]?

p.src: 52:38  Or do they have a stairway [to the heaven] by which they eavesdrop? Then let those who eavesdrop produce a compelling proof.

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: Or do they have a stairway [to the heaven] by which they eavesdrop? Then let those who eavesdrop produce a compelling proof.
u.src: 52:38  Or do they have a stairway [to the heaven] by which they eavesdrop? Then let those who eavesdrop produce a compelling proof.

p.src: 52:39  Or does He have daughters while you have sons[14]?

ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
en: Or does He have daughters while you have sons[14]?
u.src: 52:39  Or does He have daughters while you have sons[14]?

en: [14] See footnote 37:149.

p.src: 52:40  Or are you asking them [O Prophet] for a reward so they are overburdened by debt?

ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
en: Or are you asking them [O Prophet] for a reward so they are overburdened by debt?
u.src: 52:40  Or are you asking them [O Prophet] for a reward so they are overburdened by debt?

p.src: 52:41  Or do they have [the knowledge of] the unseen so they are writing it down?

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
en: Or do they have [the knowledge of] the unseen so they are writing it down?
u.src: 52:41  Or do they have [the knowledge of] the unseen so they are writing it down?

p.src: 52:42  Or do they intend a plot [against the Prophet]? But the plot of the disbelievers will rebound against themselves.

ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
en: Or do they intend a plot [against the Prophet]? But the plot of the disbelievers will rebound against themselves.
u.src: 52:42  Or do they intend a plot [against the Prophet]? But the plot of the disbelievers will rebound against themselves.

p.src: 52:43  Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.
u.src: 52:43  Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.

p.src: 52:44  If they were to see pieces of the sky falling down[15], they would still say, “[This is only] a mass of clouds.”

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
en: If they were to see pieces of the sky falling down[15], they would still say, “[This is only] a mass of clouds.”
u.src: 52:44  If they were to see pieces of the sky falling down[15], they would still say, “[This is only] a mass of clouds.”

en: [15] As a sign of the punishment that they requested.

p.src: 52:45  So leave them alone until they encounter their Day in which they will be struck down[16],

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
en: So leave them alone until they encounter their Day in which they will be struck down[16],
u.src: 52:45  So leave them alone until they encounter their Day in which they will be struck down[16],

en: [16] i.e., they will be punished on the Day of Judgment.

p.src: 52:46  the Day their plots will not avail them in the least, nor will they be helped.

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: the Day their plots will not avail them in the least, nor will they be helped.
u.src: 52:46  the Day their plots will not avail them in the least, nor will they be helped.

p.src: 52:47  And for the wrongdoers, there will be another punishment before that[17], but most of them do not know.

ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: And for the wrongdoers, there will be another punishment before that[17], but most of them do not know.
u.src: 52:47  And for the wrongdoers, there will be another punishment before that[17], but most of them do not know.

en: [17] In this world such as famine, droughts, or defeat at the battle, or punishment in the grave.

p.src: 52:48  Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [Watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
en: Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [Watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.
u.src: 52:48  Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [Watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

p.src: 52:49  And glorify Him at night and when the stars fade away[18].

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
en: And glorify Him at night and when the stars fade away[18].
u.src: 52:49  And glorify Him at night and when the stars fade away[18].

en: [18] i.e., the early hours of the morning when the stars set; the time of the Fajr Prayer.
